family_reports.body: Illegally gave children to father’s girlfriend and then gave father who has three decades of violent and sexual adjudicated criminal history
This system has destroyed my family, my daughter is more traumatized then anything she cries when she needs to return back to the other parent.

We have lost everything because of our legal cases with convicted DV abuser and his 3rd party, including being sued for $20million. I have been obtaining help & support thru local DV shelter to help rebuild. Marjoree Mason Center, Fresno, CA
